initialStyleGenerationPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: small moving vehicle icon for Hong Kong transit map.
Primary request: one cute miniature Hong Kong MTR urban-line train, based on the actual Q-Train: metallic silver body, charcoal wraparound cab windshield, bright red framing around cab glass and lower front, small orange swoosh on flank, silver roof equipment, dark rectangular side windows and sliding silver doors. A short single cab car, compact toy proportions yet recognisable real train.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with actual alpha.
Style/medium: polished 3D toy miniature, soft rounded corners, clean diecast finish, simple readable forms, soft studio lighting.
Composition/framing: one vehicle centered, entire vehicle visible, elevated almost-top-down three-quarter view. Longitudinal centerline strictly vertical, nose/bow at the TOP of the image (12 o'clock), tail at BOTTOM, see roof and right flank; the front windshield is at top. This is a heading-rotated map marker. Vehicle fills 82% of square canvas.
Constraints: a thin pale buttery-yellow cutout edge hugging the vehicle silhouette for map visibility; no background plane, no tracks, no ground, no cast shadow beyond outline, no words, no numbers, no branding, no route badge, no watermarks, no people, no face, no extra objects. No full train consist; one cab car only.
orientation: Final artwork faces nose-down; original urban prompt requested up, but the accepted generated pose faces down. Renderer applies a 180-degree heading offset.
